# GraphRAG

> GraphRAG built from scratch: entity and relation extraction, knowledge-graph construction, and traversal-based multi-hop retrieval.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag

## Source

- [src/graphrag/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/__init__.py): GraphRAG - knowledge-graph construction and traversal-based retrieval.
- [src/graphrag/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/cli.py): Command-line interface for GraphRAG.
- [src/graphrag/core/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/core/__init__.py): Core abstractions for GraphRAG.
- [src/graphrag/core/graph.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/core/graph.py): The knowledge graph: entities as nodes, relations as labeled edges.
- [src/graphrag/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/data.py): A bundled corpus and labeled questions for GraphRAG evaluation.
- [src/graphrag/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/evaluation.py): Evaluating graph retrieval against a flat text-retrieval baseline.
- [src/graphrag/extraction.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/extraction.py): Extracting entities and relations from text to build the knowledge graph.
- [src/graphrag/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/graphrag/retrieval.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/retrieval.py): Graph retrieval: linking a query to entities and traversing for an answer.
- [src/graphrag/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/graphrag/blob/main/src/graphrag/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing graph retrieval.
